mapping.migration: Pinned TEI P4-to-P5 stylesheet and source-bound DocSouth mapper; preserve text/order, actual page markers, source entity names and external graphic locators.
mapping.oracle: Independent ElementTree traversal compares complete front/body/back text, page markers, figure/entity locator sequence, source IDs, package sidecars, and TEI P5 schema.
mapping.retained_images: All 168 figure-referenced JPEG payloads are retained as exact source-support members and hash-bound by the source manifest. The P5 candidate preserves the source graphic URLs and entity sequence; it does not embed, transcribe, or visually review musical notation.
mapping.work_boundary: One complete top-level titled work produces one TEI document; internal chapters, regions, songs, and front/back matter remain within that TEI.

provenance.method: Source-bound DocSouth TEI.2 to P5 conversion with independent source-aware oracle.
provenance.source_rights: DocSouth TEI availability states No Copyright - United States: provider believes the item public domain under US law, with no determination for other jurisdictions. Electronic text/encoding rights remain as stated by provider; no worldwide rights clearance inferred.
